commands.name: test
commands.run: test -f yarn.lock || { echo 'ERROR: yarn.lock missing - this repo is yarn-only; refusing to run the gate'; exit 1; }; test ! -f package-lock.json || { echo 'ERROR: package-lock.json present - npm detour detected; delete it and reinstall with yarn'; exit 1; }; ensure-deps && yarn test

setup.name: system
setup.command: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs --no-install-recommends && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
